author: Gordon Thelander
releaseNotes: 4.6.2 extends the Presence Report window from 30 to 90 days (actual usable range still depends on the existing 500-row Activity Report retention cap, left unchanged - raise 'Activity report rows to retain' yourself if you want the wider window to fill in further back), adds a CSV export link under the Presence Report table, and attempts a second fix for diagnostics tables not scrolling horizontally on mobile after the 4.6.1 fix proved incomplete. 4.6.1 fixed two issues found after 4.5's stale-evidence flagging shipped: the advanced diagnostics tables didn't scroll properly on mobile, and the default 'ignore non-IP evidence after N hours' threshold (12h) was too short for how Hubitat mobile presence actually behaves - raised to 48 hours.
